name: Proxmox Backup Server
summary: HTTPS 8007, passed on to a self-signed backend.
notes: The target is https:// because the server only speaks TLS, with a certificate of its own that is not verified. This is for the web interface. Backup clients and Proxmox VE storage switch the connection to a backup protocol of their own and usually pin the server's certificate fingerprint, so point those at the server itself.
